title: NxHomes
description: A fully GUI-based home management plugin with zero command usage. Set, rename, and manage homes easily through an intuitive interface, with permission-based limits and high configurability.
body:
🏠 NxHomes

The Ultimate GUI-Driven Home Management System



📸 Media Showcase

Experience a 100% command-free graphical interface.



### ✨ Why choose NxHomes? Most home plugins rely on outdated chat commands that frustrate new players and clutter the chat. **NxHomes** was built from the ground up for modern Minecraft servers, focusing entirely on a frictionless user experience. Whether you run a chill SMP, a hardcore faction server, or a massive survival network, NxHomes adapts perfectly to your exact style. ### 🚀 Core Features * **🖼️ 100% GUI-Based:** Players can set, view, teleport, and manage their homes entirely through an interactive menu. * **✏️ Instant Renaming:** Customize and rename homes on the fly with a simple click—zero chat commands required. * **📍 Seamless Relocation:** Move or update a home's location instantly without having to delete and recreate it. * **🔐 Permission-Based Limits:** Give specific ranks different maximum home limits to perfectly integrate with your server's donor ranks. * **⚙️ Highly Configurable:** Tweak the menus, adjust the limits, and customize the experience to match your server's branding.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions

Because NxHomes is GUI-driven, command bloat is kept to an absolute minimum.

| Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `/home` | Opens the interactive homes GUI to view and teleport. | | `/sethome` | An alias that opens the GUI so players can click an empty slot to save a location. | | `/nxhomes` | The main admin command for managing and reloading the plugin. |
| Permission | Effect | | :--- | :--- | | `nxhomes.use` | Allows the player to use the plugin and open the GUI (Default: true). | | `nxhomes.home.` | Defines the amount of home slots unlocked (e.g., `nxhomes.home.5`). | | `nxhomes.admin` | Grants access to the `/nxhomes` admin command (Default: OP). | > **Note:** Setting, deleting, renaming, and selecting a "Main" home are all done entirely by clicking inside the GUI!

### 📦 Installation Guide NxHomes is built for modern Minecraft servers (**1.21+**) and is plug-and-play ready. 1. **Download the plugin:** Place the `NxHomes.jar` file into your server's `/plugins` directory. 2. **Restart the server:** Let the server generate the default configuration files. 3. **Set permissions:** Grant your players the base `nxhomes.use` permission, and define their maximum home slots using `nxhomes.home.` (e.g., `nxhomes.home.4` for VIPs). Note: `nxhomes.home.2` is granted by default. 4. **Customize:** Open the config to adjust the teleport warmup delays, GUI layouts, or world blacklists to fit your server's needs.
